sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Hunting Trip is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Come in, have a seat. Want some tea? Well, suit yourself. Listen, I've got a bit of a situation. I'll be having guests before long, and I can't exactly take them hunting with worn-out old rifles, can I? I've got a couple of fine foreign bolt-action rifles, but they still need to be sighted in. Then it occurred to me... why not kill two birds with one stone? Break in the rifles and thin out the ranks of those gang leaders at the same time. Don't worry kid, I'll make it worth your while."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Locate and neutralize any 20 Bosses with a bolt-action rifle

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +65,000 EXP
- +4 Bolt-action Rifles skill levels
- Jaeger Rep +1.5
- 400,000 Roubles
  - 420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- Unlocks purchase of Accuracy International AXMC .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle at Jaeger LL4
"Those rifles turned out real fine! Maybe I'll take up gunsmithing myself one day. I like this kind of work. Here's your reward, just as I promised."
